label.en: Haixi Mongol and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture
label.zh-CN: 海西蒙古族藏族自治州
label.zh-TW: 海西蒙古族藏族自治州

description.en: Haixi Mongolian and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture , locally also known as Qaidam Prefecture , is an autonomous prefecture occupying much of the northern half of Qinghai Province, China. It has an area of 325,785 square kilometres and its seat is Delingha.
description.zh-CN: 海西蒙古族藏族自治州，简称海西州，是中华人民共和国青海省下辖的自治州，位于青海省西部，因地处青海湖以西而得名。州境东北接海北州，东连海南州，东南达果洛州，南靠玉树州，西毗新疆巴音郭楞州，北依甘肃省酒泉市、张掖市，省境西南隅的唐古拉山镇由海西州管理，成为与西藏自治区那曲市邻接的一块飞地。
description.zh-TW: 海西蒙古族藏族自治州，簡稱海西州，是中華人民共和國青海省下轄的自治州，位於青海省西部，因地處青海湖以西而得名。州境東北接海北州，東連海南州，東南達果洛州，南靠玉樹州，西毗新疆巴音郭楞州，北依甘肅省酒泉市、張掖市，省境西南隅的唐古拉山鎮由海西州管理，成爲與西藏自治區那曲市鄰接的一塊飛地。

description.en: Chaka Salt Lake is a salt lake in Ulan County, Haixi Prefecture, Qinghai, China. The oval lake is located near the eastern end of Qaidam Basin, 298 kilometres to the west of the provincial capital Xining.
description.zh-CN: 茶卡盐湖，也称茶卡或达布逊淖尔，位于中国青海省海西蒙古族藏族自治州乌兰县茶卡镇境内，湖面海拔为3059米。 该湖湖水富含钠盐，盐层较厚，贴近湖面，湖水已经趋于干涸。
description.zh-TW: 茶卡鹽湖，也稱茶卡或達布遜淖爾，位於中國青海省海西蒙古族藏族自治州烏蘭縣茶卡鎮境內，湖面海拔爲3059米。 該湖湖水富含鈉鹽，鹽層較厚，貼近湖面，湖水已經趨於乾涸。

description.en: The Qaidam, Tsaidam, or Chaidamu Basin is a hyperarid basin that occupies a large part of Haixi Prefecture in Qinghai Province, China. The basin covers an area of approximately 120,000 km2 , one-fourth of which is covered by saline lakes and playas.
description.zh-CN: 柴达木盆地地处青海省西北部，阿尔金山、祁连山和昆仑山之间，面积约为120,000平方公里。是中国三大内陆盆地之一，也是中国四大盆地之一。
description.zh-TW: 柴達木盆地地處青海省西北部，阿爾金山、祁連山和崑崙山之間，面積約為120,000平方公里。是中國三大內陸盆地之一，也是中國四大盆地之一。

photo.alt: Image Caption: STS040-613-011 Qaidam Basin, China June 1991 This mostly east-looking view [here rotated to place north at the top] shows the Qaidam Basin. Located in the Northern Tibetan Plateau, the Qaidam Basin sets between two branches of the Kunlun Mountains. To the north (left edge) are the Altun Mountains and to the south (right edge) are the Qimantag Mountains. The arid basin is 350 miles (560 km) long and 100 miles (160 km) wide. A salt marsh occupies most of the basin. Oil fields and refineries are located in the west part (bottom center) of the basin. Iron ore is mined in the southern part of the basin. Coal deposits have been found in the Qaidam Basin. Cooler climate crops such as wheat, highland barley, millet, and potatoes are grown during the short, cool summer months.
